caption.story: Join me as I explore the fascinating world of cocktail textures. From the La Dolce Fizz with its lemon sorbet foam to the Ube Colada Float's vibrant purple hue, these drinks are all about layers and unexpected flavors. And yes, mozzarella water in cocktails is a thing! It adds a creamy texture without the cream. Dive into the details of how these innovative ingredients come together to create a unique drinking experience.
